notes: Echo: a polite shimmering mimic (standard rig). A smooth chrome body with no seams: every surface is shaded like a mirror ball (a bright sky band, a hard dark horizon line under it, a ground tone with a faint violet bounce, a vertical specular streak), a long smooth head, tube limbs ending in plain rounded mitts, slim capsule legs. It copies whoever is near: a faint lilac figure of a person is mirrored in a pane on the back, and the mimic head wears a faint copy of a face. The shimmer is the glow layers: torso_glow and head_glow have 4 frames (head_glow 4 per head variant) at ~4 fps, a soft diagonal sheen sweeping across the body. Head variants: smooth, mimic (a faint face), helmet (a polished cap with a tinted band and a mirror visor strip). Outfit mask = the sash, the armbands, the cap band. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.

glow.notes: per head variant, a list of glow frames: alternate them at 4 fps
